picture-pairs.name: Omathano ge thike pamwe
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Uudhano wokutsakanitha omathano gombili: Omathano ge thike pamwe
picture-pairs.h1: Omathano ge thike pamwe: Uudhano wombili wokutsakanitha
picture-pairs.description: Uudhano wongushi wombiili wokutsakanitha omathano kaantu mboka taye lumbu nuudhigu wokudhimbwa. Omathano omanene ohaga kala taga monika, kapu na oshipala shethimbo nenge oondondo dhonomola, nohamu hogolola omathano 4 sigo 12.
picture-pairs.short: Konga omathano gaali ge thike pamwe. Omathano otaga vulu okukala ga patuluka.
picture-pairs.intro: Thinya kethano limwe, e to thinya kwekwawo lye li fa. Omathano ohaga kala ga patuluka opo paaha kale sha sha pumbiwa okudhimbulukwa komutse. Uuna omathano gaali ge li kumwe, ohaga mono omunkulo gwangodhi yoshingoli noshidhindikitho sheuvathano.
howTo: Hogolola kutya owala omathano gangapi mwa hala okulongitha. Omathano gane ogo ehala ewanawa lyombili okutameka.
Thinya kethano kehe. Otali ka mona omunkulo gwoshilaingoli.
Thinya kethano ndyoka lya faathana nalyo. Omathano ngoka gaali otaga kala kumwe ye na oshilongitho shokutala.
Ngele omathano gaali inaga faathana, kapu na sha sha puka tashi ningwa. Thinya natango monkatu yoye uuna wa longekidha.
Patulula "Omathano ga holekwa" owala ngele mwa hala okuuvite nawa uudhano wokukonga kombinga yokupatulula omathano konima.
tips: Lukeni omathano pombanda pamwe nomu popye kombinga yago: "Okapu koote kokatiligane. Oho tula mo omashini mote yoye?"
Etha omuntu ngoka to sile oshimpwiyo a thinye komashina, nonando otashi kutha ethimbo lile. Ulika nomunwe pehala lyokutsinya pehala lye.
Kalei nomathano gane ethimbo ele ngele otashi mu ningitha mu kale mu uvite nawa. Omathano ogendji ehogololo owala, hoshikondo sha pumbiwa okutsikilwa.
Maneni manga mu uvite nawa. Uudhano wumwe owala oshi li oshinyangadhalwa sha gwana nawa.

faq.q: Openi pu na osho ethimbo nenge oondondo?
faq.a: Aaye. Kapu na ovili, oondondo dhonomola, okukonga iinano nenge okukanitha. Oto vulu okukankama ethimbo kehe, nokukankama mokati otashi vulu okukala omukalo omwaanawa gokuhulitha.

faq.q: Omolwashike omathano haga kala ga patuluka?
faq.a: Okukaleka omathano taga monika ohaku ningi uudhano wu kale wokutala nokutsakanitha pehala lyokudhimbulukwa. Aantu oyendji ohaye shi tala shi na ombili oyindji. Oto vulu okupingena komathano ga holekwa methinyo limwe ngele owe shi hala.

faq.q: Owongushi tuu, nandi pumbwa tuu okuninga eishangitho?
faq.a: Eeno, owongushi, na kapu na ombalambele yoinyolwa, eishangitho nenge okukutha ko sha. Ohawu longo kombinga yepandja lyointaneta mongodhi, motableta nenge mokompiyuta.

faq.q: Otatu vulu tuu okulongitha omathano getu geni gosegeli?
faq.a: Eeno. Yeleka Omathano gomapandja, hoka taku ku pitike wu hogolole omathano moshikwaelektronika shoye. Omathano ohaga kala mowindowa yoye na ihaga londo kointaneta yopombanda.

find-the-same.name: Konga ethano lya faathana
find-the-same.seoTitle: Konga Ethano Lya Faathana: Uudhano Wuupupu Womadhiladhilo
find-the-same.description: Ethano limwe pombanda, gaali sigo gane kohi. Thinya kwekwawo ndyoka li thike pamwe nalyo. Uudhano wombili wongushi wokutsakanitha omathano kaantu mboka taye lumbu nuudhigu wokudhimbwa, kawa na oshipala shethimbo.
find-the-same.short: Tala kethano ndyoka li li pombanda e to thinya kulyo ndyoka lya faathana nalyo kohi.
find-the-same.intro: Ethano limwe oli li kombinga yopombanda yoshiwiliki. Kohi yalyo opu na omathano gaali, gatatu nenge gane. Thinya kwekwawo ndyoka lye li fa. Oshiningwanima shimwe sha yela poshikando, shi na ethimbo lya gwana lyokupopya.
howTo: Hogolola omathano gaali, gatatu nenge gane gokuhogolola mo. Gaali ogo omapu noonkondo.
Taleni pamwe kethano ndyoka li li pombanda.
Thinya kethano ndyoka lya faathana nalyo kohi. Otali dhimbulukwa nawa nomushangwa gweuvathano noohapu dhomwenyo omwaanawa.
Ngele pwa thinywa kethano lyi ili, uudhano otawu tumbula owala edhina lyalyo e tawu tegelele. Kutha ethimbo lyoye.
Thinya "Ethano li landula" uuna mwa longekidha okumona limwe.
tips: Popyeni kombinga ya kehe ethano manga inamu li hogolola: omalwaalo, omaumbililo, naampoka tamu vulu oku li mona.
Omahoololo gaali kage shi "okaapu unene". Eshilongo olyo ethimbo ewanawa lyombili, hoshikumungu shuudhigu.
Ngele okuthinya okwa kaka, omuntu ngoka ota vulu okuulika nomunwe e to mu thinyine.

faq.q: Openi pu na osho ethimbo nenge oondondo?
faq.a: Aaye. Kapu na ovili, oondondo dhonomola, okukonga iinano nenge okukanitha. Oto vulu okukankama ethimbo kehe, nokukankama mokati otashi vulu okukala omukalo omwaanawa gokuhulitha.

faq.q: Oshike tashi ningwa ngele pwa thinywa kethano lya puka?
faq.a: Kapu na sha shi nayi tashi ningwa. Kapu na ondungidha, omushigakano omutiligane nenge okukakama. Uudhano ohawu tumbula owala ethano ndyoka lya thinywa e tawu tegelele ethinyo li landula.

faq.q: Owongushi tuu, nandi pumbwa tuu okuninga eishangitho?
faq.a: Eeno, owongushi, na kapu na ombalambele yoinyolwa, eishangitho nenge okukutha ko sha. Ohawu longo kombinga yepandja lyointaneta mongodhi, motableta nenge mokompiyuta.

shadow-match.name: Tsakanitha nomuzizimba
shadow-match.description: Omuzizimba omuluudhe pombanda, omathano gaali sigo gane kohi. Thinya kethano ndyoka tali ningi omuzizimba ngoka. Uudhano wongushi wombiili wokutsakanitha omuzizimba kaantu mboka taye lumbu nuudhigu wokudhimbwa, kawa na oshipala shethimbo.
shadow-match.short: Tala komuzizimba e to thinya kethano ndyoka tali gu ningi.
shadow-match.intro: Okutsakanitha omuzizimba oshityalonga shi shiwiki nawa koombapila dhoinyangadhalwa, ngashingeyi shi na omathano omanene nokwaa na sha sha pumbiwa okunyanyangidhwa. Omuzizimba omwaanawa ogu li pombanda yoshiwiliki nomathano gaali, gatatu nenge gane oge li metegelo kohi. Thinya kwekwawo ndyoka tali ningi omuzizimba. Omaumbililo ngaashi obasikela, okagumbo komvula nenge okapu koote oshipu okupopya kombinga yago wo.
howTo: Hogolola omathano gaali, gatatu nenge gane gokuhogolola mo. Gaali ogo omapu noonkondo.
Taleni komuzizimba pamwe. Ogu na olupe luni? Ogu li omule nenge omungungumanu?
Thinya kethano ndyoka tali ningi omuzizimba. Edhina lyalyo otali holoka kohi yomuzizimba.
Ngele pwa thinywa kethano lyi ili, uudhano otawu tumbula owala edhina lyalyo e tawu tegelele. Kutha ethimbo lyoye.
Thinya "Omuzizimba gukwawwo" uuna mwa longekidha okumona gulwe.
tips: Shileni omunkulo gwomuzizimba nomunwe e tamu popi kombinga yoolupe lwayo.
Ngele omizizimba odha fa odhidhigu nena, pingena ku Konga ethano lya faathana, mpoka omathano ga yela ga faathana.
Popya kombinga yethano uuna lya monika: "Otwa li tu na okagumbo komvula ka fa nkene."

faq.q: Openi pu na osho ethimbo nenge oondondo?
faq.a: Aaye. Kapu na ovili, oondondo dhonomola, okukonga iinano nenge okukanitha. Oto vulu okukankama ethimbo kehe, nokukankama mokati otashi vulu okukala omukalo omwaanawa gokuhulitha.

faq.q: Okukonga shadow matching oku na okuwa kovanhu ovo ve na dementia?
faq.a: Oku nokuwa oshinima shiwa sha tya ngoo kovamwe, unene mesiku lyopambelepo. Iifano ohai kwatwa nokuziwa unene kuposhi yomashiwa. Oshinima oshi shi shi pewa okutsiwa nokuyandja omukumwe, kohaashi okulinga ondjelelo. Oshi kahai ondje dementia nokai kwatwa. Ngele oshi ta tula omahepeko, ove nkamwe mu kolelele "Kongeni ofano yefano" nkamwe mu tale iifano pamwe.

faq.q: Ngele ota tendeleka ifano yi ka inayi, ota ka ihala shike?
faq.a: Ohaashi kukala shiwa shi shi shi tihe. Ihaaku na eyuvo lyoosinda, nokapitale ka, nokupula. Omukumwe ogu ota popi ifano yi tendelekwa nota kongela ondjadi yokutendeleka.

faq.q: Oshi na ondyelelo, nolyi yo ku ninga omunyoli?
faq.a: Eehe, oshi na ondyelelo, kaku na ekonto, kaku na okuninga omunyoli nokuvatuka. Ota ka shi kwatwa mo mo web browser mo fone, tablet nomo computer.

sort-together.name: Kulanduluka pamwe
sort-together.seoTitle: Omukumwe gwo kulanduluka dementia: Kulanduluka pamwe
sort-together.description: Tendeleka ifano, opo to kuthike mo mohoto yalyo: kokudhiginini nomutunda, omaketama nomadhiva. Oshinima shi shi li shi shi tulaho, shi shi na ondyelelo, kovanhu ovo ve na dementia.
sort-together.short: Kulanduluka ifano mo mohoto yayo: kokudhiginini, komutunda nokuli.
sort-together.intro: Okulanduluka oshinima shi shi tya ngoo, shi shi kwatwa unene, ngaashi okuthika oiwiyo mo kiinka, nokukonga omalaka. Tendeleka ifano, opo tho ka kuthike mo mohoto yalyo. Ihaku na ondjila yo kukala nokuya nokwiyelela.
howTo: Sokoleka omulandu: kokudhiginini nomutunda, omaketama nomadhiva, nomukuta nomukuhewa.
Tendeleka ifano. Oyo ota ka kala ina ondjia yegolide.
Tendeleka mohoto yayo ifano ei i li mo. Ifano oyo ota ka yi mo mohoto yayo.
Ngele ifano ei i li mohoto yimwe, omukumwe ogu ota ka popi nokupewa omukumwe nokukonga.
Ifano ayihe ikwatwa, tala omahoto pamwe.
tips: Mo nawa kohaashi kakuna omaeshiwa ga yandjwa ga ka. Ngele omuntu a popi ngoo ondyulo yomvuthu i li mo kiinka, kopa omukumwe kapa tulike ngoo. Ota ka kala ngoo nomauyelele maupu.
Kwatha iifano ngaashi ondjelelo: "Oho hi kwakwe elyulo lyoshi?"
Okulanduluka oihinyo yomaumbo ngaashi omathala nomakele nomakuta oshi ikala omukumwe gwa tuka nawa kohaashi ko kunyoka tyo ketiyoko.

faq.q: Oku na okaunda nokukwaniseka?
faq.a: Kakuna. Kakuna okaunda, okukwaniseka, omadhiginino gokutendeleka nokupya. Ota kwata okusiya nekuku ngeyi, nokusiya kokati ohaku kala omukumwe gwa tya nawa okupwaka.

faq.q: Ongaho oshi lande?
faq.a: Ovanhu vamwe ohaa kwatwa nokulanduluka, ngoo oshi shi shi shi ina omukumwe nawa nokushi ziwa. Oshi shi shi ohayi ondjelelo, unene ngeyi ota popi iifano.

faq.q: Oshi na ondyelelo, nolyi yo ku ninga omunyoli?
faq.a: Eehe, oshi na ondyelelo, kaku na ekonto, kaku na okuninga omunyoli nokuvatuka. Ota ka shi kwatwa mo mo web browser mo fone, tablet nomo computer.

picture-puzzle.name: Ifano yokutula pamwe
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Omutula gwefano gwo dementia: 4 nomo 9 omadhina
picture-puzzle.h1: Ifano yokutula pamwe: omutula gu gwa tuka nawa
picture-puzzle.description: Omutula gwefano gu gwa tuka kovanhu ovo ve na dementia: omadhina 4 nomo 9 ga kulu, efano lyoshili otali monika, nota pindi omadhina mawili opo ga kwafaneke.
picture-puzzle.short: Pindi omadhina mawili opo ga kwafaneke, kuza kompolo efano lyoshili lya kala.
picture-puzzle.intro: Efano lyo kutwima lyanyanyukwa kuma kumwe oshi shi kumwe, shi shi pondo 4 nomo 9 ga kulu, nalyo lyokongela. Efano lyoshili otali monika ngaashi ondjelelo. Pindi edhina limwe, opo ota pindi limwe, nagwa kwafaneke. Ihaashi tiwa.
howTo: Sokoleka efano nomadhina 4 nomo 9. Mane ya 4 ohaayi kwatwa nawa.
Tala efano lyoshili kombinga.
Pindi edhina, opo ota pindi moshikumwe shishi edhina ei ta ka ina okukala. Omadhina mawili ota ka kwafanekwa.
Omadhina ei i li mo mekumbo lyawo ota ka kala ina ekwatho lipi.
Efano kompolo lyoshili lya kala, lipite pamwe, opo mu sokoleke efano lingwe.
tips: Okupindi omadhina mawili opo ga kwafaneke oku ikala kupupu kovanhu vamwe kohaashi okutiwa.
Popi kefano ngeyi lyu tula: "Oho hi kwakwe ondjapo yoka ndyoyo."
Omutula gwefano gwa mapuva ngaashi ogwa mamu gu na omadhina 12 nomo 24 ga kulu oshi ikala omukumwe gwa tuka nawa pehi lyomeza.

faq.q: Otandi kwata okutiha omadhina?
faq.a: Ihaashi. Pindi edhina limwe, opo ota pindi limwe, nagwa kwafaneke. Oshi shi shi shi ohayi kohaashi ngoo ombwanda ei i tila shi, nokuli elalakanyo lyoshi lyoshi lyo mapuva.

finish-the-saying.name: Pwanesa ondjovela
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Pwanesa ondjovela: omukumwe gwomaindjovela gwo vanhu vamanenene
finish-the-saying.description: Iindjovela ya ziwa, ngaashi "Omulenge gu li moningwe ota gu kala omulenge gu nawa ..." ihe ngoo ondjovela yomukuda ya thigwa. Tendeleka ondjovela, nokonga ondjovela ngeyi, nopopi.
finish-the-saying.short: Pwanesa iindjovela ya ziwa pamwe, nopopi pakaathi.
finish-the-saying.intro: Iindjovela ya kala nayi kukwatwa muuyuni washo. Okalata nokaindjovela kamwe kaina omuthigo gwa thigwa, ondjovela ei i li mo nomakongo matatu, nomakwatho "Monika ondjovela". Opo pauyuvo gwondjovela, omulandu ta ka ulikwa.
howTo: Popa ondjovela moshitsa pamwe.
Tendeleka ondjovela ei ya pwanesa, nkamwe monika ondjovela.
Popa ondjovela nokuya popi kombinga yayo.
Pindi "Ondjovela ilwe" ngeyi mu mono kutya mu na okuya.
tips: Popa nokukala nokonga mo kakai ko kulingeka ndyoka lyopomhito ndjoka. Shingaho ohaa popitha nokuli ko kwiyuda.
Ngele omuntu a tula ondjovela ngoo ya shuna, hwahwa. Iindjovela oyo ya kala ya shuna kovanhu ovo kovalumbo nomaumbo.
Omuvi vonga oshi shi shi ndi popa, nomuntu yomwe nomukuta ota ka inyanyuka mo ondjovela.

faq.q: Oku na okaunda nokukwaniseka?
faq.a: Aaye. Kapu na o-wili, oondondo, etalelo lyoomwenyo nenge esindiko. Oto vulu okukankama pethimbo kehe, nokuhulila pokati oko wo omukalo omwaanawa gokumanitha.

faq.q: Ongiini ngele otwa hogolola oshitya shi ili?
faq.a: Uudhano otau ulike ehulilo ndyoka li shiwike e tau tsikile noonkundathana. Kapu na oondondo, neyamukulo lya yooloka oli li nawa lela.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nenge onda pumbwa okwishangitha?
faq.a: Eeno, oshali lela, no kapu na okaaunda, okwishangitha nenge okulonga mo sha. Ohawu longo kombinga yokukonga komapandja go-ngodhi, kotablete nenge kokompiyuta.

word-search.name: Omakongo giitya yoondanda oonenene
word-search.seoTitle: Omakongo giitya yoondanda oonenene yuuvu wokudhimbwa, taga vulu okunyanyangidhwa
word-search.description: Omakongo giitya gowala goondanda oonenene gaakokele naantu mboka taya lumbu nuuvu wokudhimbwa. Iitya iishona, oondanda oonenene, iitya ya thikama noya lala owala. Dhana ko-intaneta nenge u nyanyangidhe.
word-search.short: Oondanda oonenene, iitya iishona, ya lala noya thikama owala. Nyanyangidha wo.
word-search.intro: Okagolomba okapewa koondanda oonenene niitya iishona yowala, ayihe otai leshwa ya lala nenge ya thikama. Thinina kondanda yotango yoshitya, opo ihe to thinine kondanda yasho yahugunina. Owa hala yopombapila? Nyanyangidha uudhano uupe nethinino limwe owala.
howTo: Hogolola oshipalanyolo noonkondo dhokagolomba.
Tala komusholondondo gwiitya. Iitya otai leshwa ya lala (kombinga yokolumoho sigo oyokolulyo) nenge ya thikama (kombanda sigo opevi).
Thinina kondanda yotango yoshitya, opo ihe to thinine kondanda yasho yahugunina.
Oshitya sha monika otashi ningi erangano e tashi kuthwa ko komusholondondo.
Thinina "Nyanyangidha uudhano mbuka" opo mu dhane kombapila nepensela nenge okapeniko.
tips: Ulikileni oshitya shi li momusholondondo e tamu kongo ondanda yasho yotango pamwe.
Kombapila, okapeniko okapukululi ohaka kwatwa nuupu shi vulithe opensela.
Kundathaneni kombinga yiitya yoshipalanyolo. Iitya yiiyimati oyo omukalo omuwanawa gwokutampeka omadhimbuluko gokuteya, okulonga iikuki nenge omahala gomalandithilo.

faq.q: Opu na tuu o-wili nenge oondondo?
faq.a: Aaye. Kapu na o-wili, oondondo, etalelo lyoomwenyo nenge esindiko. Oto vulu okukankama pethimbo kehe, nokuhulila pokati oko wo omukalo omwaanawa gokumanitha.

faq.q: Ondi vulu tuu okunyanyangidha uudhano wokukonga iitya?
faq.a: Eeno. Thinina "Nyanyangidha uudhano mbuka" opo u nyanyangidhe okagolomba koondanda oonenene, nomusholondondo gwiitya pevi lyako. Kehe uudhano uupe owa yooloka.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nenge onda pumbwa okwishangitha?
faq.a: Eeno, oshali lela, no kapu na okaaunda, okwishangitha nenge okulonga mo sha. Ohawu longo kombinga yokukonga komapandja go-ngodhi, kotablete nenge kokompiyuta.

coloring.name: Omapandja gomalwaala
coloring.seoTitle: Omapandja gomalwaala gaakokele mboka ye na uuvu wokudhimbwa (Gowala)
coloring.description: Omapandja gomalwaala omapu gaakokele ge na omahala omanene: thinina elwaala, opo ihe to thinine pethano. Kapu na evundakano, kapu na elwaala lya puka, no kehe epandja otali vulu okunyanyangidhwa gowala.
coloring.short: Thinina elwaala, opo ihe to thinine koshitopolwa shethano. Nyanyangidha wo omapandja.
coloring.intro: Omapandja ge na omathano omapu omanene: ongala mondjaye, egumbo, okakopi kotee, embiimbili nowato yomeya. Thinina elwaala, opo ihe to thinine koshitopolwa shethano oku shi udhitha. Kapu na omalwaala ga puka.
howTo: Hogolola epandja.
Thinina elwaala. Kehe elwaala oli na edhina lyalyo lya nyolwa ko.
Thinina koshitopolwa shethano oku shi udhitha nelwaala ndyoka.
Lundulula edhiladhilo lyoye ethimbo kehe mokutula mo elwaala limwe.
Thinina "Nyanyangidha epandja ndika" opo mu mone epandja lyaa na sha lyokuhola noopensela nenge nookapeniko.
tips: Gandja omalwaala gaali ga hogololwe mo pehala lyokugandja agehe ngele okuhogolola otaku monika oshidhigu.
Omiti dhuuludhe nomatango gomambulau oga taambwa ko nawa. Shika oshi na sha nokunyanyukilwa omalwaala, ha kukala we shi ninga mondjila lela.
Omapandja ga nyanyangidhwa ohaga longo nawa nookapeniko oomanene nenge noomoni, ndhoka oondjato dhadho dhuupu okukwata.

faq.q: Opu na tuu o-wili nenge oondondo?
faq.a: Aaye. Kapu na o-wili, oondondo, etalelo lyoomwenyo nenge esindiko. Oto vulu okukankama pethimbo kehe, nokuhulila pokati oko wo omukalo omwaanawa gokumanitha.

faq.q: Omapandja ngaka oga fa tuu guunona unene?
faq.a: Otwa thaneka iinima iipu ya ngungumana pehala lyoomanga dhuunona, opo omapandja ga opalela aakokele. Omathano omanene ohaga ningi elwaala li kale epepu lyaa shi shuunona.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nenge onda pumbwa okwishangitha?
faq.a: Eeno, oshali lela, no kapu na okaaunda, okwishangitha nenge okulonga mo sha. Ohawu longo kombinga yokukonga komapandja go-ngodhi, kotablete nenge kokompiyuta.

conversation-cards.name: Uukalata woonkundathana
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Omatameko goonkundathana guuvu wokudhimbwa: Uukalata womathano
conversation-cards.description: Uukalata womathano ye na omatameko omawanawa goonkundathana gaantu mboka taya lumbu nuuvu wokudhimbwa: kapu na omakonakono, kapu na omayamukulo gomondjila. Longitha posikilini nenge u nyanyangidhe uukalata auhe.
conversation-cards.short: Uukalata womathano ge na omapulo omawanawa ga patuluka. Kapu na omakonakono.
conversation-cards.intro: Kehe okakalata oke na ethano li shiwike pamwe nehitho ewanawa lyokupopya, ngaashi "Ombepo yini yoombepo dhuunshitwe wu hole unene?" Kapu na omayamukulo gomondjila nenge sha shoka sha pumbwa okudhimbulukwa. Hogolola oshipalanyolo nenge u piagule agehe kumwe.
howTo: Hogolola oshipalanyolo, nenge u thige po "Uukalata auhe".
Lesha epulo mokule e tamu tala kethano pamwe.
Pulakena, gandja eyamukulo lyoye gwoye, e tamu etha oonkundathana dhi pumbuluke.
Thinina "Okakalata taka landula" ngele mwa pyakudhukwa, nenge mu kale nokakalata kamwe ethimbo ele ngaashi mwa hala.
Thinina "Nyanyangidha uukalata auhe" opo mu tete mo uukalata wopombapila.
tips: Yamukula wo epulo nangoye mwene. Shika ohashi ningi shi kale oonkundathana dhashili, kashi shi epulapulo.
Landula ehokololo, hamauyelele gomondjila lela. Ngele uuyelele owu lunduluka, oshi li tuu nawa.
Ngele okakalata oka gumu sha shoka shi lulilwe, taamba ko eiyuvo ndyoka e tamu lundulukile kokakalata kamwe nombili.

faq.q: Omolwashike kaapu na omapulo ga tya "Oto dhimbulukwa tuu…?"
faq.a: Omapulo ngoka taga konakona edhimbuluko otaga vulu okukala ga fa ekonakono nokweetitha ehuliloko. Omahitho ga patuluka ngaashi "Hokololela ndje kombinga ya…" ohaga pe kehe gumwe ompito yokukutha ombinga, kashi na ndando kutya oshike ta dhimbulukwa.

faq.q: Ondi vulu tuu okunyanyangidha uukalata?
faq.a: Eeno. "Nyanyangidha uukalata auhe" otaku nyanyangidha uukalata auhe mondanda onene, uukalata uundji kepandja kehe, wa pyakudhukwa okutetwa mo.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nenge onda pumbwa okwishangitha?
faq.a: Eeno, oshali lela, noinaapu pumbiwa okukala no-akhaunda, okwiishangitha nenge okuninika sha (download). Otashi longo kobrawusa yongodhi, yotableta nenge yokompiuta.

photo-pairs.name: Oothano dhomataele
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Ninga uudhano wokukonga omataele okuza moothano dhuukwanegumbo
photo-pairs.h1: Oothano dhomataele: Konga omataele goothano dhoye yene
photo-pairs.description: Ningitha oothano dhoye dhuukwanegumbo uudhano uuwanawa wokukonga omataele. Hoolola oothano 2 sigo 6 moshikwaelektronika shoye; otadhi kala mobrawusa yoye noitadhi tuminwa nando kointaneta.
photo-pairs.short: Hoolola oothano dhoye yene e to dhi hanganitha. Kape na sha tashi tuminwa kointaneta.
photo-pairs.intro: Hoolola oothano mbali sigo hamano okuza mongodhi, motableta nenge mokompiuta yoye, opo dhi ninge uudhano wokuhanganitha oothano dhi li oonenene nodhi wetike nawa. Oothano otadhi ulikwa ashike meni lyepandja ndika. Itadhi tuminwa kointaneta, itadhi pungulwa nenge dhi taandelithwe, notadhi kana po uuna to pata epandja.
howTo: Thinda "Hoolola oothano" e to kutha mo oothano mbali sigo hamano.
Kehe ethano otali holoka luwali. Thinda limwe, opo nduno to thinda etaele lyalyo.
Popyani kombinga yakehe ethano sho tamu li mono.
Uuna mwa mana, pata epandja nenge u thinde "Kutha mo oothano". Kape na sha tashi pungulwa.
tips: Hoolola oothano dhi li nawa dhiinima yinyanyudha noyoshiwike: oshinamwenyo shomegumbo, oshikunino, ehala eholike, nenge esiku lyohango.
Oothano dhomahala nodhiinima otadhi vulu okukala oompu dhi vulithe oshipala shomuntu, noitadhi tula omuntu monkalo yokuthiminikwa a tye omadhina gaantu.
Yanda oothano dhaantu mboka ya hulitha ngele otadhi vulu okueta oluhodhi lwoombaadhilila, kakele ngele owu shi shi kutya otadhi eta ehekeleko.

faq.q: Oothano dhandje otadhi tuminwa tuu pehala li ili kointaneta?
faq.a: Aawe. Epandja ndika otali lesha oothano ndhoka wa hoolola mondjila oyo tuu ndjoka mobrawusa yoye e tali dhi ulike kosikrina yoye. Itadhi tuminwa kutse nenge komuntu gumwe e lili, notadhi kana po uuna to pata nenge to shunitha epandja pevi.

faq.q: Opu na tuu owili nenge oondondo?
faq.a: Aawe. Kape na owili, oondondo, okuyalula oonkatu nenge okusindwa. Oto vulu okukankama pokathimbo kehe, nokukankama mokati oku li lela omukalo omwaanawa gwokumana.

faq.q: Ondi vulu tuu okupungula uudhano mbuka opo tu ka dhane koshikando tashi landula?
faq.a: Hasho mobrawusa, osho sha ningwa ngaho opo ku shilipalekwe kutya kape na uuyelele wopaumwene tawu pungulwa. Okapulikeishina koshali kaGolden Moments ko-iPhone noko-iPad otaka vulu okupungula oothano ndhoka wa hoolola moshikwaelektronika shoye.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo yoothano
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo yoothano yaakulupe mboka ye na uupyakadhi wokudhimbwa: Oyi li yokunyanyangidhwa
picture-bingo.description: Bingo yoothano yoshali yokunyanyangidhwa ya nuninwa aakulupe naamboka taya silwa oshimpwiyo shoompadhilila, yi na omwiithani omunene kosikrina. Oothano oonenene kumwe niitya, uukololo 9 nenge 16, noinaapu pumbiwa okulesha.
picture-bingo.short: Uukalata woobingo yoothano wokunyanyangidhwa nomwiithani gokosikrina onene ya nuninwa oongundu.
picture-bingo.intro: Obingo yoshito ya ningwa noothano pehala lyonomola, opo kapu kale gumwe ta pumbwa okulesha uushona. Nyanyangidha uukalata wi ili nowi ili, opo nduno to longitha omwiithani gwokosikrina okuulika kehe ethano li li enene kotiivii, kokompiuta nenge kotableta.
howTo: Hoolola uukololo 9 nenge 16 kekalata kehe nongundu yaadhaneni.
Thinda "Nyanyangidha uukalata". Kehe ekalata oli ili.
Egula omwiithani kosikrina onene. Thinda "Ethano tali landula" okuulika kehe ethano kumwe nedhina lyalyo.
Aadhaneni otaya siikile ethano ndyoka lye ya pamwe kekalata lyawo noshimaliwa shoshiyela, ombatona nenge oshikwatha shokundhindhilikitha.
Kehe ngoka ta gwanitha omukweyo, nenge ekalata alihe, oha pandulwa. Kape na aasindwa molupe nduka: tsikileni okudhana sigo kehe gumwe a mono omukweyo.
tips: Longitheni iinima iinenene ngaashi omitonho dhomakende. Oombatona ooshona otadhi vulu okukala oodhigu okukwatwa.
Tumbula ethano e to popi sha kombinga yalyo: "Oskepa yombepo. Olye a li nale moskepa?"
Kuutumbikeni aantu mboka ye na uupyakadhi wokumona po popepi lela nosikrina, e tamu tula aakwathi pamwe naadhaneni mboka ye ya pumbwa.
Uukololo omugoyi owu gwana lela koongundu odhindji. Kalekeni ethimbo lyokudhana pokati kominiti 20 sigo 30.

faq.q: Ongiini tandi vulu okudhanitha obingo yoothano megumbo lyesiloshimpwiyo lyakulupe?
faq.a: Nyanyangidha ekalata limwe komudhaneni kehe, tula omwiithani kosikrina onenenene ndjoka wu na, e to ithana oothano kashona nakashona, to tumbula edhina lyakehe shimwe. Dhaneni sigo kehe gumwe a mono omukweyo, opo kapu kale ngoka a thigwa pevi.

faq.q: Oshali tuu okunyanyangidha?
faq.a: Eeno. Nyanyangidha uukalata wu thike pomwaalu ngoka wa pumbwa, olundji ngaashi wa hala, wu li gwopeke nenge gwokulongithwa mongundu.

faq.q: Aantu otaya vulu tuu okudhana nando inaaya lesha?
faq.a: Eeno. Kehe okakololo oke na ethano enene, li na edhina lyalyo pevi lyalyo kwaamboka ye hole iitya.

calm-breathing.name: Efudho lyokungungumana
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Okathimbo kokufudha kwangungumana kaakulupe naamboka taye ya sile oshimpwiyo
calm-breathing.description: Okathimbo kokufudha kashona nowonakuzi hoka tamu vulu okukala pamwe: onguluvi yi li ombili otayi koko notayi shuna pevi luhamano lwomifudho. Ngoye to shi tameke, notowu vulu okukankama pokathimbo kehe.
calm-breathing.short: Onguluvi tayi ende kashona yokufudha nayo. Tameka e to kankama uuna wa hala.
calm-breathing.intro: Omathimbo gamwe oshilonga oshiwanawa lela oko ashike okukala mwamwena uule wokathimbo. Thinda "Tameka", opo nduno to futila mo sho onguluvi tayi koko, e to fudhila pondje sho tayi shuna pevi. Hoolola okweenda kashona nenge mbala. Kashi shi epango lyasha, oshi li ashike ethimbo lyombili lyokukala pamwe.
howTo: Kuutumbeni monkalo yuuwanawa pooha nooha.
Hoololeni ondapo: kashona nenge ombili.
Thinda "Tameka". Futila mo manga onguluvi tayi koko, e to fudhila pondje manga tayi shuna pevi.
Otayi kankama yoyene konima yomifudho hamano, nenge u thinde "Kankama" pokathimbo kehe wa hala.
tips: Kwatathani komake nenge u tule eke lyoye kokwooko kwomuntu ngoka to sile oshimpwiyo ngele osho a hala.
Ino thiminika nando. Ngele oya hala ashike okutala, oshi li nawa.
Ngele omuntu oku na uupyakadhi wokufudha, na fudhe ngaashi shito e ta tala ashike konguluvi. Puleni kundohotola kombinga yuupyakadhi kehe wokufudha.

faq.q: Shika oshinyangadhalwa tuu shopaundjolowele shokufudha?
faq.a: Aawe. Oshi li ashike okathimbo omapu kehalo lyoye kokukala nombili nokweetathana pamwe. Kashi shi epango lyomaipulo nenge lyuukolele washa. Popya nandohotola kombinga yuupyakadhi kehe wuundjolowele.

faq.q: Onguluvi ohayi inyenge tuu nando inandi yi tameka?
faq.a: Aame. Inashi kukala mbela wa tiya "Start", nokuli omahepo 6 ota kwatha, nenge ngeno wa tiya "Stop". Ngele edhiyaminwa lyoye li shiva okuhuka kwouyelele, omashongo ota yandjagulwa ihe ekuli inali kundjidhwa.

faq.q: Ohaa pumbwa okulipa, nosho ohaa pumbwa okudhiginina?
faq.a: Ee, oha lipwa keshi, nosho ihaa pumbwa konto, okudhiginina nenge okulanduka. Ota shi kwathela mo webrauza yefoni, tabuleti nenge komputa.
